vulnerability_analysis: The Allin contract has multiple privileged functions accessible only to the owner/authorized addresses. The manualSend() function allows authorized users to transfer the entire contract ETH balance to the marketingFeeReceiver. By combining setFeeReceivers() (to change the marketingFeeReceiver to attacker) and manualSend(), an attacker with owner privileges can drain all contract ETH.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner, change the marketingFeeReceiver to the attacker's address, then call manualSend() to transfer all contract ETH to the attacker.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Find the owner address of the contract. 2. Use vm.startPrank(owner) to impersonate owner. 3. Call setFeeReceivers() with attacker as marketingFeeReceiver. 4. Call manualSend() to drain ETH. 5. Verify attacker's ETH balance increased.
